blocks.html: The short version: you request a quote, we confirm the details with you, and your order is placed once you approve it.
blocks.text: The short version: you request a quote, we confirm the details with you, and your order is placed once you approve it.

blocks.html: Checking out on our website sends a quote request. It is not a payment or a binding order. We review your build, confirm pricing, delivery and timing with you, and your order is placed only once you approve it and payment is arranged. By placing an order, you agree to these terms.
blocks.text: Checking out on our website sends a quote request. It is not a payment or a binding order. We review your build, confirm pricing, delivery and timing with you, and your order is placed only once you approve it and payment is arranged. By placing an order, you agree to these terms.

blocks.html: Prices are in Canadian dollars and are manufacturer’s suggested retail prices (MSRP). HST (13%) is added and shown separately. Prices and availability can change until your order is confirmed, and we’ll correct any obvious pricing errors before confirming.

blocks.html: You are responsible for any permits your property needs. In Ontario, an accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit; check with your municipality. Electric heaters and chillers must be connected by a licensed electrician, and the work is subject to Electrical Safety Authority (ESA) requirements.

blocks.html: Electric heaters carry the certifications listed on each product page. Sauna rooms and kits are not certified as complete assemblies by CSA or WETT. Wood-burning heaters must be installed to the manufacturer’s instructions and local code, and we recommend a WETT-certified installer.

blocks.html: Saunas and cold plunges carry real health considerations. Talk to your doctor before use if you are pregnant or have heart, blood pressure or other medical conditions, and always follow the owner’s manual.
